triggerReason: Local replication, remote provenance, off-host recovery, live-provider exercise and elapsed production time were described separately but lacked one fail-closed public contract, making it too easy for a local pass or operator flag to be read as external proof.
action: Added a five-lane trust matrix, exact bundle and signed-receipt verification, distinct off-host identity evidence, GitHub-hosted replication/recovery receipt workflows, persisted DeepSeek-shadow and wall-clock gates, a read-only API, bilingual Human Observatory panel, unit/browser failure coverage and deployment runbooks.
outcome: Implementation 7182378 verifies the local v4.7 bundle while honestly retaining external CI, off-host recovery, live DeepSeek and 90 elapsed days as independent pending lanes. Reference contract tests can reach 5/5 only with exact signed subjects and reject tampering, expiry or same-host identity. The full gate passes 257 non-PostgreSQL plus 16 real PostgreSQL/restore tests, 27 production-build Playwright/axe scenarios, zero lint warnings, zero audit vulnerabilities and TypeScript/build. Production deployment will be recorded after release.
evidence: Signed receipt binds repository, workflow, release revision, subject digest and lane summary
Off-host evidence requires distinct SHA-256 source and restore target fingerprints
Live DeepSeek requires persisted attempts, comparable output and nonzero Token usage
90-day lane requires actual runtime envelopes plus lineage, freshness, revision and timing gates
